upstream.commercial_descendants: GMX V2 collateral sum is an unsigned per-(market, collateralToken, isLong) total. applyDeltaToUint rejects a negative next uint, then ALWAYS checks maxCollateralSum (including on decrease). Distinct from OI (max only when delta>0, swap-only revert) and from applyBoundedDeltaToUint (floor at 0).
